description: import/rnews.rs:227-248 and tests/rnews_ingest.rs:52-73 — make_article() and make_batch() are copy-pasted between the unit tests inside the parser module and the integration test. They are currently identical but will drift as soon as either file is touched. A format change (e.g. different Date header, CRLF vs LF) fixed in one place will leave the other silently producing subtly different fixtures. Better approach: move make_article and make_batch into a shared test-fixtures module (e.g. transit/src/import/test_fixtures.rs, cfg(test)) or into a common dev-dependency crate, and import from both test sites.
title: make_article/make_batch test helpers duplicated
